notes.title: Dodge Dummy - Latest update (visual overhaul and fixes!)
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The latest Dodge Dummy update brings you a new soundtrack and many new textures.

We've added a better looking background and re-designed obstacles. 

Some obstacles have also been re-designed to make the hitboxes of them seem more accurate which should make the game feel more responsive now.

Thanks for the feedback which has been provided and we hope that you will enjoy this update!
